periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping downwards towards the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward taper terminating in a rounded point near the maxillary region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and semicircular with a smooth rounded apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brown/ochre staining on the ventral fur and inner pelvic region.
